title: De Ridders
summary: "De Ridders" by Aristophanes is a comedy written in 424 BC. This satirical play targets Cleon, a powerful Athenian politician who had previously prosecuted Aristophanes. Through contests of shameless flattery and outrageous boasts, the rivals battle for political control.
